To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
student evaluation of teaching is an effective way to improve teaching quality and the quality assurance system, and it is necessary for the university to construct a scientific evaluation system.
the student evaluation of teaching is a fundamental policy for quality assurance in higher education.
student evaluations of teaching (SET) are a useful tool in improving teaching quality in higher education, but that they need to be implemented with care.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following issues.
student evaluation of teaching as a fundamental policy of the teaching quality control system of universities.

the following aspects: (1) the basic concept of student evaluation of university instruction, and its role and significance in the teaching quality assurance of HEIs; (2) the basic principle of student evaluation of HEI teaching; (3) the design and implementation of student evaluation system of university instruction; (4) the application of student evaluation of instruction in the quality assurance and improvement of university instruction.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the student evaluation system of teaching should not only be a tool to improve the quality of teaching, but also a tool for teachers to improve their own teaching quality, and it should be used as an objective and fair tool to evaluate teachers' teaching quality.

student evaluation of teaching should be regarded as the basis of teaching quality assurance, and the system of student evalutation of teaching should be improved to ensure the scientific and effective implementation of student evaluation of teahing.

the teaching quality assurance in higher education is a systematic project which is based on the teaching evaluation system, and the teaching quality assurance should be a continuous process which is conducted by the teachers, the teaching management and the students.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we should establish correct view on student evaluation of teaching,to construct scientific system of student evalua-tion of teaching,and to draw upon the sophisticated experiences from abroad so as the quality assurance system in China.

the quality assurance system for university instruction in our country has been gradually established,which has played an irreplaceable role in promoting the teaching reform and quality improvement of university education.

the student evaluation of teaching is a kind of teaching quality assurance system which can reflect students' opinion about the teaching quality and the satisfaction degree to the teaching quality,and it is a kind of effective method of improving teaching quality and enhancing the quality assurance of teaching in higher educational institutions.
The main takeaway from our work is that

we need to make sure that student evaluation of teaching is used as an effective tool to improve teaching quality,which will help students to become more active and creative in learning,and help teachers to improve the teaching quality.
we have a lot of room for improvement in the way we teach our students.
the evaluation system should not be designed to be too complex and the evaluation should be conducted in a more systematic way.
